title: Exhortation concerning work and conduct with the disorderly
description: Paul exhorts the church in Thessalonica to stay away from those who live disorderly lives and refuse to work. He reminds them of his own example: he and his coworkers worked night and day so as not to be a burden, and gave the rule that 'the one who is unwilling to work shall not eat.' The disorderly should be admonished but not regarded as enemies, rather as brothers.
